wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Calanthe Town |image=Calanthe Town.png |imagesize=300px |characters=エビネタウン |japanese=Ebine Town |region=Kalos |epicode=XY027 |episode=To Find a Fairy Flower! }} '''Calanthe Town''' (Japanese: '''エビネタウン''' ''Ebine Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is located between [[Cyllage City]] and [[Geosenge Town]]. It has a [[Pokémon Center]] and the Calanthe Town Central Hospital, which treats humans. As [[Florence]] fell ill, she was taken to the local hospital by ambulance. While there, even though she had recovered from her illness, she went into a state of emotional despair because the {{p|Flabébé}} that lived with her and her husband {{OBP|Grey|XY027}} had gone missing. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were passing through town, Grey rushed towards them because they had Flabébé with them, as they had found her earlier. Flabébé needed a new fairy flower to survive, and so Ash and his friends went to look for one in the highlands neighboring Calanthe Town.
